This tests that textarea wrap attributes work correctly when submitting a form.






wrap=hard : Success


wrap=soft : Success


wrap=off : Success


wrap=hard rtl text: Success


wrap=hard mixed rtl and ltr text: Success


wrap=hard visibility:hidden: Success
